workspace.plugins.heldtemplates.help: A plugin can hold templates of its own, for example to store what it fetches through an API client. Take one over from the Templates workspace or type its YAML here. The copy is stored inside the plugin and travels with its zip. The template is created in the open context folder when you click 'Create template', when the plugin zip is imported, and when the plugin is run: before the script starts. A template that already exists is never replaced.
